Class PlannerView

java.lang.Object
mvc.AbstractView
planner.ui.PlannerView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelListener, View
public class PlannerView extends AbstractView
Main view for the student planner application. Provides a tabbed interface for managing students, courses, and tasks.
